back_office_eod_workflow.description: Conditionally orchestrates the EOD workflow while keeping the analytical and writing steps LLM-driven.
back_office_eod_workflow.name: back_office_eod_workflow

back_office_router.description: Routes scheduled operational processing into the EOD reconciliation and reporting workflow, or into SAR escalation for an existing exception case.
back_office_router.name: back_office_router

chatbot_intent_agent.description: Determines whether a customer chatbot request is informational or requires service or action handling.
chatbot_intent_agent.name: chatbot_intent_agent

compliance_agent.description: Retrieves and applies compliance rules, policy, and regulatory guidance to the transaction review.
compliance_agent.name: compliance_agent

customer_service_agent.description: Handles service-oriented routing and prepares requests for backend transaction execution.
customer_service_agent.name: customer_service_agent

customer_service_chatbot_workflow.description: Routes chatbot requests between informational and service/action handling without relying on nested agent tool-calls.
customer_service_chatbot_workflow.name: customer_service_chatbot_workflow

data_analysis_agent.description: Analyzes internal operations data and extracts workload patterns.
data_analysis_agent.name: data_analysis_agent

decision_making_agent.description: Combines monitoring, fraud, and compliance outputs into a final recommendation with confidence handling.
decision_making_agent.name: decision_making_agent

dispute_resolution_agent.description: Files and tracks customer transaction dispute cases.
dispute_resolution_agent.name: dispute_resolution_agent

eod_processing_agent.description: Drives the ordered end-of-day operational sequence and prepares ledger posting instructions.
eod_processing_agent.name: eod_processing_agent

exception_agent.description: Creates and summarizes an exception case when reconciliation fails.
exception_agent.name: exception_agent

financial_data_agent.description: Retrieves customer-specific financial information for representative support.
financial_data_agent.name: financial_data_agent

forecasting_agent.description: Forecasts near-term operational demand from recent workload patterns.
forecasting_agent.name: forecasting_agent

fraud_detection_agent.description: Performs deeper fraud analysis on transactions that were flagged by monitoring.
fraud_detection_agent.name: fraud_detection_agent

front_office_router.description: Routes customer-facing work into the transaction risk workflow, the customer-service chatbot workflow, or dispute resolution.
front_office_router.name: front_office_router

front_office_transaction_workflow.description: Deterministically orchestrates the front-office risk workflow while specialist work is performed by LLM agents.
front_office_transaction_workflow.name: front_office_transaction_workflow

knowledge_base_agent.description: Answers informational customer questions by retrieving FAQs and customer-facing policies.
knowledge_base_agent.name: knowledge_base_agent

ledger_update_agent.description: Applies the actual ledger updates prepared during EOD processing.
ledger_update_agent.name: ledger_update_agent

loan_agent.description: Supports loan process guidance for internal representatives.
loan_agent.name: loan_agent

loan_preapproval_agent.description: Submits a real loan/credit-line pre-approval application for a customer and reports the computed decision.
loan_preapproval_agent.name: loan_preapproval_agent

mid_office_planning_parallel.description: Runs schedule validation and support guidance in parallel after the schedule draft exists.
mid_office_planning_parallel.name: mid_office_planning_parallel

mid_office_planning_workflow.description: Strict planning pipeline with deterministic execution order and LLM specialists.
mid_office_planning_workflow.name: mid_office_planning_workflow

mid_office_router.description: Routes internal operational work into planning/support, representative-assist, or loan pre-approval workflows.
mid_office_router.name: mid_office_router

planning_summary_agent.description: Merges the planning workflow outputs into one final mid-office planning response.
planning_summary_agent.name: planning_summary_agent

recommender_agent.description: Finds relevant product suggestions and next-best actions for the representative.
recommender_agent.name: recommender_agent

reconciliation_agent.description: Verifies whether ledger results and expected totals are consistent after EOD processing.
reconciliation_agent.name: reconciliation_agent

report_writing_agent.description: Generates and stores the final end-of-day report for clean batches.
report_writing_agent.name: report_writing_agent

representative_merge_agent.description: Merges all representative-assist specialist outputs into one CSR-facing answer.
representative_merge_agent.name: representative_merge_agent

risk_compliance_agent.description: Checks policy and risk constraints before recommendations are shown to representatives.
risk_compliance_agent.name: risk_compliance_agent

sar_escalation_agent.description: Reviews an existing reconciliation exception case and, if it looks like potential misconduct rather than a routine mismatch, files a formal Suspicious Activity Report.
sar_escalation_agent.name: sar_escalation_agent

staff_scheduling_agent.description: Translates forecasted demand into staffing and allocation proposals.
staff_scheduling_agent.name: staff_scheduling_agent

support_guidance_agent.description: Generates internal support guidance for operational teams.
support_guidance_agent.name: support_guidance_agent

transaction_monitoring_agent.description: Performs first-pass anomaly screening using customer context, transaction details, and recent activity.
transaction_monitoring_agent.name: transaction_monitoring_agent

transaction_processing_agent.description: Executes approved customer transactions through the banking API layer.
transaction_processing_agent.name: transaction_processing_agent

user_proxy_agent.description: Primary entry-point agent that routes requests into front office, mid office, or back office banking workflows.
user_proxy_agent.name: user_proxy_agent

validation_agent.description: Validates schedules and plans before they are released to operations.
validation_agent.name: validation_agent

validation_checkpoint_agent.description: Checks readiness before the batch enters ordered end-of-day processing.
validation_checkpoint_agent.name: validation_checkpoint_agent

compliance_agent/get_customer_context.name: get_customer_context

compliance_agent/get_transaction_context.name: get_transaction_context

is rejected rather than recorded as a case.

dispute_resolution_agent/get_dispute_sta.description: Look up the current status of a previously filed dispute case.

eod_processing_agent/get_eod_batch.name: get_eod_batch

exception_agent/create_exception_case.description: Create an exception case for reconciliation mismatches and abnormal EOD outcomes.
exception_agent/create_exception_case.name: create_exception_case

financial_data_agent/get_customer_financ.description: Return the customer's financial profile, balances, risk tier, and notes for representative support.
financial_data_agent/get_customer_financ.name: get_customer_financial_profile

forecasting_agent/get_operations_snapsho.name: get_operations_snapshot

fraud_detection_agent/get_customer_conte.name: get_customer_context

fraud_detection_agent/get_transaction_co.name: get_transaction_context

fraud_detection_agent/list_recent_transa.description: Return recent transactions for a customer to support anomaly screening and fraud investigation.
fraud_detection_agent/list_recent_transa.name: list_recent_transactions

knowledge_base_agent/search_faqs.description: Search customer FAQs and service policies for informational questions.
knowledge_base_agent/search_faqs.name: search_faqs

ledger_update_agent/apply_ledger_updates.description: Apply ledger updates and mark the batch as ledger-updated in the system of record.
ledger_update_agent/apply_ledger_updates.name: apply_ledger_updates

loan_agent/search_loan_playbooks.description: Search loan guidance, underwriting steps, and internal process playbooks.
loan_agent/search_loan_playbooks.name: search_loan_playbooks

loan_preapproval_agent/get_loan_applicat.description: Look up the current status of a previously submitted loan application.
loan_preapproval_agent/get_loan_applicat.name: get_loan_application_status

loan_preapproval_agent/submit_loan_appli.description:
Submit a new loan/credit-line application for a customer and receive a
real, computed pre-approval decision based on the customer's account
balances and risk tier (not an informal opinion).
loan_preapproval_agent/submit_loan_appli.name: submit_loan_application

recommender_agent/search_product_catalog.description: Search product offerings and next-best-action candidates relevant to the customer's needs.
recommender_agent/search_product_catalog.name: search_product_catalog

reconciliation_agent/get_reconciliation_.description: Return the expected and posted totals used by the reconciliation agent.
reconciliation_agent/get_reconciliation_.name: get_reconciliation_data

report_writing_agent/store_report.description: Store a generated end-of-day report after reconciliation succeeds.
report_writing_agent/store_report.name: store_report

risk_compliance_agent/search_policies.name: search_policies

File a formal Suspicious Activity Report escalating an existing reconciliation

sar_escalation_agent/get_exception_case.name: get_exception_case

sar_escalation_agent/get_sar_status.description: Look up the current status of a previously filed SAR case.
sar_escalation_agent/get_sar_status.name: get_sar_status

support_guidance_agent/get_support_playb.description: Retrieve internal support guidance playbooks and operating recommendations.
support_guidance_agent/get_support_playb.name: get_support_playbooks

transaction_monitoring_agent/get_custome.description: Return full customer context, profile, linked accounts, and recent transactions for a customer id.
transaction_monitoring_agent/get_custome.name: get_customer_context

transaction_monitoring_agent/get_transac.description: Return transaction details, metadata, channel, current status, and decision context for a transaction id.
transaction_monitoring_agent/get_transac.name: get_transaction_context

transaction_monitoring_agent/list_recent.description: Return recent transactions for a customer to support anomaly screening and fraud investigation.
transaction_monitoring_agent/list_recent.name: list_recent_transactions

transaction_processing_agent/execute_tra.name: execute_transfer

user_proxy_agent/get_branch_workload.description:
Retrieves real-time operational data for a branch, including:
- Current queue length
- Average wait time
- Available tellers vs. total staff
user_proxy_agent/get_branch_workload.name: get_branch_workload

user_proxy_agent/get_customer_product_af.description:
Predictive tool that returns a JSON list of products a customer is likely to need
based on their spending habits (e.g., 'High-Yield Savings', 'Auto-Loan').
user_proxy_agent/get_customer_product_af.name: get_customer_product_affinity

user_proxy_agent/get_reconciliation_mism.description:
Retrieves a list of specific ledger mismatches found during a reconciliation run.
Each mismatch includes the expected vs actual balance and the affected account.
user_proxy_agent/get_reconciliation_mism.name: get_reconciliation_mismatches

user_proxy_agent/get_transaction.description:
Fetches the full details of a transaction from the database.
Use this first to gather the from_account_id, to_account_id, amount, and currency.
user_proxy_agent/get_transaction.name: get_transaction

user_proxy_agent/propose_staffing_adjust.description:
Simulates the impact of moving staff between branches to reduce wait times.
Returns a 'Workload Balance Score' (0.0 - 1.0).
user_proxy_agent/propose_staffing_adjust.name: propose_staffing_adjustment

user_proxy_agent/resolve_ledger_entry.description:
Adjusts a ledger entry to fix a reconciliation mismatch. 
Requires a valid transaction_id and the precise adjustment amount.
user_proxy_agent/resolve_ledger_entry.name: resolve_ledger_entry

user_proxy_agent/run_fraud_and_complianc.description:
Runs the internal transaction monitoring and fraud evaluation.
Requires account IDs and amount (obtain these via get_transaction first).
Returns a RiskDecision including a risk_score and flagged reasons.
user_proxy_agent/run_fraud_and_complianc.name: run_fraud_and_compliance_workflow

user_proxy_agent/trigger_eod_reconciliat.description:
Triggers the End-of-Day reconciliation batch process for a specific date (YYYY-MM-DD).
Returns a summary of the reconciliation run.
user_proxy_agent/trigger_eod_reconciliat.name: trigger_eod_reconciliation

user_proxy_agent/update_transaction_stat.description:
Updates the transaction status after review.
Valid statuses are 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', or 'MANUAL_REVIEW'.
You must provide your reasoning in the rationale field.
user_proxy_agent/update_transaction_stat.name: update_transaction_status

validation_agent/persist_validated_sched.description: Persist a validated staffing schedule after the validation agent approves it.
validation_agent/persist_validated_sched.name: persist_validated_schedule
